text:
1 scam report in Mountain Home for week ending Aug. 1, 2026
Mountain Home recorded one scam report for the week ending Aug. 1, 2026, according to Better Business Bureau.
That was a decline from two reports during the previous week.
There was one report of losses totaling $1,420.
The largest reported loss for the week was $1,420 in a rental scam. I applied online to rent an apartment. The man kept demanding more fees. I spent a total of $1,420 trying to rent the apartment and never received the keys. He is refusing to return my money. I have asked very nicely for him to do so. He keeps asking why? I told him I was no longer interested in renting the property.
BBB Scam Tracker lets consumers search reported scams and share their own experiences to help others recognize similar schemes. The BBB says it reviews each report before publication and does not publicly display the reporter’s name or personal contact information.
Fraud reports have continued to include substantial financial losses nationwide. The Federal Trade Commission said consumers reported losing more than $12.5 billion to fraud in 2024, a 25% increase from the previous year.
